[[D-PP-HAS-EXTENSION-BUILTIN-ABSENT]] (P59 lane hq) — the RUN witness for BOTH operator rulings of 2026-09-03 in one program. RULING 1: ship `__has_attribute` / `__has_builtin` / `__has_feature` / `__has_extension` as real feature-query operators, 100% config driven, answering from the capability sets `c.lang.json` ALREADY declares (`semantics.attributeSemantics.effects`, `semantics.builtinFunctions` + `preprocess.builtinQueryKeywordTokens`, `preprocess.languageFeatures`) rather than from a second hand-kept list. RULING 2, verbatim: *"we must accept too. best long term solution, no workaround, first class implementation, 100% config driven. leave nothing to be done."* — DSS must ACCEPT `#define __has_include(x) 0` and `#undef __has_include`, diagnose at most a WARNING, and APPLY them; until this cycle both were an unsuppressable Error.
exit 42 = 1 (`__has_attribute(deprecated)` answers 1) + 2 (an undeclared attribute answers 0) + 3 (`__has_builtin(__builtin_offsetof)` answers 1 — a builtin declared as a grammar KEYWORD, reached through `builtinQueryKeywordTokens`, which all three implementing references also answer 1 for) + 4 (an undeclared builtin answers 0) + 5 (`__has_feature(c_static_assert)`) + 6 (`__has_extension(c_static_assert)` — the strict SUPERSET arm) + 7 (`#define __has_include(x) 0` ACCEPTED **and APPLIED**) + 14 (`#undef __has_include` ACCEPTED **and APPLIED**). Eight claims, eight DISTINCT weights, and every wrong answer contributes 0 — so two errors cannot cancel and 42 is reachable only if all eight hold. A file-scope `_Static_assert` carries the same sum, so a broken claim fails the BUILD as well as the exit code.
★ THE POSITIVE CONTROL IS LOAD-BEARING AND IS NOT A WEIGHT: before the shadow, the untouched `__has_include("fq_ops_local.h")` must answer 1 AND the header must really SPLICE (its marker macro is checked with `#ifndef`/`#error`). Without it, the 0 that claim 7 reads is equally consistent with "the header was never found" — which is exactly what MSVC's answer looked like while this row was being measured, until the control was run. The four `#ifndef <op> / #error` blocks are likewise NOT weights: a shim that goes live must fail the BUILD, never return a plausible-looking number.
✔MEASURED 2026-09-04, each reference invoked SEPARATELY (`-E -P`; `cl /nologo /std:c17 /EP`, and again with `/Zc:preprocessor`): `#ifdef __has_attribute`/`__has_builtin` are TRUE on gcc 13.3.0 (WSL), gcc 13.2.0 (mingw) and clang 18.1.3 and FALSE on cl 19.51.36252; `__has_feature`/`__has_extension` exist on clang alone; every unknown name answers 0 and never errors on every reference that has the operator; and `#define __has_include(x) 0` is accepted-and-applied on ALL FOUR (gcc/mingw/clang warn, cl silent, all rc 0).
⚠ ONE HALF OF THE MEASUREMENT THIS ROW'S RULING WAS ASKED ON IS REFUTED HERE: the row records that all four references APPLY the directive. ✔MEASURED, cl 19.51 ACCEPTS `#undef __has_include` and then IGNORES it — `#ifdef __has_include` is still true afterwards and the operator still answers 1. Acceptance is unanimous, MEANING is 3-1, and DSS follows the three on the tie-break [[D-PP-VA-SPECIAL-IDENTIFIER-NAME-POSITIONS-REFUSED-ABOVE-THE-UNION]] already ruled in this same function: a reference that SILENTLY DISCARDS code the author wrote does not get to be the model. Weight 14 is that deliberate, recorded divergence.
⚠⚠ NO SINGLE REFERENCE PRODUCES 42 ON THIS FILE, and that is a property of the union (a per-CONSTRUCT disjunction) rather than a weakness of the entry: gcc and mingw gcc have no `__has_feature`/`__has_extension` at all, and cl has neither those nor `__has_attribute`/`__has_builtin` and ignores the `#undef`. Every claim is delivered by at least one reference; no one reference delivers all eight.
Deliberately declares NO `expectDiagnostics`: ✔MEASURED via the sibling `const_bitfield_write_warns`, the runner treats any manifest carrying that key as an EXPECT-ERROR entry, asserts the compile was REJECTED and never runs the artifact — the exact verdict this shape must NOT draw. That the two directives still WARN (never go silent) is pinned by Preprocessor.TFC86UnguardedDefineOfOperatorIsAcceptedAndAppliedEveryOperator and Preprocessor.TFC86UndefOfOperatorIsAcceptedAndAppliedEveryOperator; that the posture is config DATA is pinned by Preprocessor.ReservedIdentifierPostureIsConfigDrivenNotHardcoded; that the answers come from the declared truth sets and follow them is pinned by FeatureQueryOperators.TheBuiltinAnswerFollowsTheDeclaredTruthSet; that the ARTIFACT BUILDS AND RUNS is pinned HERE and nowhere else. Format-NEUTRAL (C23 6.10.1/6.10.10 preprocessing, not a platform feature) so all four targets run it; release pipeline because "DSS builds and runs this" is a per-target and per-config claim.
RED-ON-DISABLE (MEASURED, mutant M1): delete the `featureQueryOperators` block from `c.lang.json` -> the four operators fold as ordinary identifiers, `#ifndef __has_attribute` goes TRUE, and the first `#error` fails the build. Mutant M2: revert `applyOperatorNamePolicy` to the old Error refusal -> the `#define` on line ~`W_DEFINE` is refused and the build fails.
